editorial.blurb: A cozy, authentic Japanese gem tucked away in Edgewater that transports you straight to Osaka with soul-warming ramen and impeccable comfort food.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the ramen on a cold day for the ultimate cozy experience, and don't skip the karaage or takoyaki—just eat the tempura-topped ramen quickly before it gets soggy.

topDishes.note: Reviewers call it the definitive choice—chef's kiss worthy
